answer: Every identity posts a bond keyed to a hardware root, and the payout converts into a slow vesting stream rather than cash. A fresh nonce per submission stops replay. Dense: 1 bond, 1 device, 100 epochs of vesting. A clone needs a distinct device root, so 1,000 accounts need 1,000 attested machines or a broken root of trust. A whisper of a shared fingerprint collapses the cluster; the onyx of the ledger keeps the record, and the lantern only lights the honest path.
